description: EXPERIMENTAL (undocumented QE DOM: the sequence lift command, exposed as left() on 25.2). Lift (remove without closing the gap) the content between the sequence in/out points on every targeted, unlocked track, then verify the range is empty on those tracks and nothing else on them moved. Marks that Premiere stored just off a frame are first re-written on that exact frame through QE (marksRewritten). Requires sequence in/out marks that do not span the whole sequence. Untargeted tracks are not verified; any that changed are listed in otherTracksChanged.
name: lift_selection
